mods.name: TBA Lite Stubs
mods.description: Compatibility stubs for TBA-Lite modpack — registers payload types and blocks from StreamCraft, SynthCraft, SceneCraft, CoreCurriculum, and ShapeCraft

releases.notes:
Compatibility stubs JAR for TBA-Lite modpack. Registers payload types and blocks from StreamCraft, SynthCraft, SceneCraft, CoreCurriculum, and ShapeCraft so TBA-Lite clients can complete the Fabric handshake with the TBA server.

Hosted here so packwiz can reference it via URL instead of bundling it as an override (which trips Modrinth AutoMod's unidentified-content check).

readmeSummary: A lightweight variant of the TBA modpack for The Block Academy CMP. Same server, fewer mods, lower system requirements.
